observed.caption: A busy urban intersection with pedestrians and cars in front of a blue and white Bank of India building and a distinctive twin-tower high-rise with a red antenna.
observed.description: The photo shows a wide urban street intersection under an overcast sky. In the foreground a paved road with a dark hatchback driving toward the camera and a white SUV further back on the right. Traffic lights hang over the intersection from poles on the right. On the left a large leafy tree stands beside a sidewalk where a group of people are walking and standing near a crosswalk. In the center a low white building with blue trim and white vertical columns displays signage, with a freestanding post holding two clock faces in front of it. Behind it rises a tall building with two cylindrical striped towers and a tall red lattice antenna between them. To the right of the tall building a large yellow billboard is mounted above smaller shopfronts with blue awnings, and a red-brick multi-story building is visible further down the street. Streetlights, utility poles and additional vehicles are visible along the road.
